last_result.headline: Q42 closed the group-correction line. The taxonomy LOOKS real (quintile spreads 0.5-1.7 ft) but a split-half test on disjoint 380-well halves shows only the 2 ROW-level features reproduce; every WELL-level feature ANTI-correlates. Arithmetic explains it: per-well residual std 6.673 over ~152 wells per quintile gives SE ~0.54, the size of the observed spreads -- effective n is WELLS, not rows. OOF group-constant corrections: best +0.0065, 2 of 13 positive, 0 of 13 clear the 3-well 5th, none helps a majority. ANSWER TO THE TASK'S QUESTION: coarsening moves R^2 from Q16's -0.0802 to ~-0.001 -- it removes the over-fitting but converges to ZERO, so the failure mode changes and the conclusion does not.
